text:
Circle of girls,
a circle of a thousand girls
around me:
O God, I am mistress
of this radiance!


On the barren earth,
over that desert
bitten by the sun,
my circle of girls
like an immense flower!


On the green plain,
at the foot of the mountains
that the voice struck,
the circle was one
single divine trembling!


On the immense steppe,
on the desolate steppe
of desolation,
my circle of girls
ablaze with love!


In vain they tried
to break my stanza
with tribulation:
the circle sings it
beneath God's care!

translation.title: Circle of Girls
